description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead for NetBox Core, a team in our Applications group.

NetBox is a product that reaches people in a few ways: our open source community runs NetBox OSS; commercial customers use NetBox Cloud (SaaS) or NetBox Enterprise (self-managed). NetBox Core builds NetBox and its core plugins, the code that runs everywhere NetBox runs. We work closely with NetBox Delivery, the team that ships NetBox and runs it on Cloud and Enterprise.

As Tech Lead, you set the technical direction for NetBox Core and stay hands-on in the code. You bring deep Django and Python skills, experience running Django in production SaaS at scale, and a good understanding of Kubernetes and SRE practices.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build NetBox and its core plugins, across the data model, business logic, APIs, and integrations

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of NetBox and its core plugins, as the team's primary technical decision maker

  • Keep NetBox fast and reliable as data and usage grow, from query performance to background jobs

  • Drive NetBox releases, including versioning, release notes, and the release cadence

  • Lead and mentor the team's engineers through design and code review, and set the team's standards for testing and documentation

  • Take part in community contributions and public design discussions on GitHub

  • Work with NetBox Delivery and the Cloud, Enterprise, and Foundations teams to build observability into NetBox, define release contracts, and drive cross-team changes through RFCs

  • Act as a technical escalation point during incidents and make sure postmortem actions get done

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a production system or platform area

  • Deep Python and Django expertise, including running a Django SaaS application in production at scale

  • A track record of finding and fixing Django performance problems, including ORM query optimization, Postgres indexing and query plans, schema design, and migration risk on large tables

  • Production experience with background job queues such as RQ or Celery, and message brokers such as Redis or RabbitMQ

  • Experience building observability into applications, including error reporting, distributed tracing, metrics, and structured logging, with tools such as OpenTelemetry and Sentry

  • A working understanding of how Python applications run on Kubernetes, and of SRE practices such as SLOs, incident response, and postmortems

  • Experience leading engineering work without formal manager authority, including mentoring other engineers

  • Hands-on experience building inside an AI-augmented development harness, including Claude Code and the workflows that make agentic tooling reliable

  • A track record of making technical decisions under ambiguity and driving work across team boundaries, from writing the RFC to getting a cross-team migration done

  • Comfort working in the open, including discussing designs in public issues, reviewing community contributions, and writing user-facing documentation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience building deep inside Django's internals, such as the app registry, model metadata, and the schema editor, for example to create models at runtime as our Custom Objects plugin does

  • Experience with the parts of the Django ecosystem NetBox uses, such as Django REST Framework, GraphQL with Strawberry, django-filter, and django-mptt

  • Experience with advanced Postgres features, such as schemas for multi-tenancy or branching, advisory locks, and connection pooling

  • Hands-on experience with several tools in our delivery stack: AWS, Kubernetes and Helm, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD or FluxCD, Terraform, and Prometheus and Grafana

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup or high-growth organization

  • Familiarity with the NetBox ecosystem or network automation

  • Contributions to or maintenance of an open source project

  • Experience with self-managed or on-premises delivery

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.
